verdict.rationale: The pack only implies an account-level concept. Feature flags can target by 'group' (posthog-docs-6), and Salesforce/HubSpot data can be synced and joined with events and persons in SQL using GROUP BY (posthog-docs-9, posthog-docs-17), so company-level aggregation is possible as a SQL workaround. Nothing shows funnels, retention or trends being analyzed at the account level. Missing for 10: documented group/company-level analytics in funnels and retention insights, a native account entity for aggregating behavior, B2B account dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
